differs: Dedup is by request_id over the whole DB (TokenTracker), so the fork copy in s-fork counts once; tokscale keys on (session, request) and counts it twice. Rows without request_id are skipped (TokenTracker): tokscale counts them per row_id (the glm-5-2-max-1m row, 31134/147/8), but every replayed copy gets a new row_id. Rows without a metrics block are pending and skipped until finalized. A corrected sibling keeps the larger value per field (180/25/30), which is TokenTracker's 235.
